title: Wavelet-based grid adaptation with consistent treatment of high-order sharp immersed geometries
summary: Wavelet-based grid adaptation methods use multiresolution analysis for error estimation, offering a mathematically rigorous approach to adaptive grid refinement when solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). However, applying these methods to PDE discretizations with immersed geometries is challenging, as standard interpolating wavelet transforms lose consistency near non-grid-aligned boundary intersections.
